observed_anchors: Current product main EntityOS Initial Grant Sandbox run 31930675508 failed before any step started; its job had no executed steps, so this is infrastructure/no-start evidence rather than code evidence.

The separate String hostcall discriminator branch 1a4664234f53a58ed4e9fe2c4040293b5dd323ac defines the current Int-only control and an explicit not-yet-admitted String process signature, but sandbox run 31937820574/job 95142430453 also failed before steps, so that branch has no executed exact-head artifact evidence.

Prior local receipts already established that explicit non-UTF8 argv Bytes can round-trip on POSIX and that embedded NUL is rejected at the argv boundary; this experiment therefore targeted a different hidden alias: host-language str plus surrogateescape.
grf.generated_reality: If Clay String is lowered directly through a host Python str on POSIX, lone surrogate code points may be converted back into arbitrary non-UTF8 argv bytes by surrogateescape, silently collapsing the intended String/Bytes distinction.
grf.counter_reality: The host str/process boundary rejects lone surrogates before execution, so a direct host str carrier already enforces a Unicode-only String boundary.
grf.falsifier: Pass one normal Unicode control and one lone-surrogate U+DCFF string as distinct argv elements to a child process; have the child report the exact filesystem-encoded bytes.
grf.predicted_if_generated_reality: The normal control is UTF-8 stable while U+DCFF is accepted and re-encoded to raw byte FF.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality: The lone-surrogate argument is rejected before child execution.

unusual_experiment.name: LONE_SURROGATE_STRING_TO_ARGV_ALIAS
unusual_experiment.rollback: child processes only; no product or user state mutated

primary_external_evidence.fact: On POSIX, surrogateescape maps undecodable bytes 0x80..0xFF to lone surrogates U+DC80..U+DCFF and maps those surrogates back to the original bytes on encoding; the PEP explicitly discusses byte smuggling and security risk.
primary_external_evidence.evidence_role: mechanism corroboration, not substitute for local measurement

architecture_delta.required_invariant: Canonical Clay String must not inherit Python/POSIX surrogateescape semantics. String admission/serialization must reject surrogate code points U+D800..U+DFFF and use explicit strict Unicode/UTF-8 semantics. Arbitrary OS octets belong to an explicit Bytes value path. Any Bytes-to-argv path must separately reject embedded NUL because the POSIX argv ABI cannot represent it inside an argument.
architecture_delta.anti_shortcut: Do not treat Python str, filesystem text, shell text, argv bytes, Clay String, and Clay Bytes as one interchangeable representation.
architecture_delta.next_discriminating_product_test: When the String-valued process hostcall is implemented, add a deterministic normal regression that rejects a lone-surrogate String before Linux effect dispatch while preserving the existing explicit Bytes/non-UTF8 behavior and NUL fail-closed boundary.
architecture_delta.rollback: If later canonical Clay String semantics intentionally include opaque surrogate tokens, keep them in a distinct host-adapter/opaque type and do not expose them as normal String semantics.
